international.title: Trump made up to $15m on Nvidia stock after Huang’s return
international.summary: Asia-Pacific stock markets rise after US president says he ‘convinced’ chipmaker’s board to reinstate CEO Comment: Nvidia’s humiliated board should resign out of embarrassment Business live – latest updates Donald Trump made up to $15m (£11.5m) on his holdings of Nvidia stock after the US chipmaker’s share price soared on the surprise return of Jensen Huang as chief executive . Huang, who co-founded the company in 1993, was ousted by the board after allegations that he had three affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy and two with employees. But the Nvidia board reinstated him after an intervention from the US president. Continue reading...

international.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
international.summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.
